source: Garage release notes, GET https://git.deuxfleurs.fr/api/v1/repos/Deuxfleurs/garage/releases (rows taken from the 'Security' sections)
note: Garage is developed on git.deuxfleurs.fr (Forgejo), not GitHub, so it has no GHSA entries; the release notes' Security sections are the authoritative list. `ref` is the upstream issue/PR number. first_patched is the first release carrying the fix. No secret, host or account data. Refresh by re-reading the source and adding any new row; a row never changes meaning.
